content: Plausible Analytics' unique-visitor model (the direct industry precedent for D-06): visitorHash = hash(daily_salt + site_domain + ip + user_agent), salt rotated+deleted every 24h, raw IP/UA never persisted anywhere. Guarantees a visitor cannot be correlated day-to-day (old salt destroyed). This is exactly the shape D-06 specifies; validates the design as an established pattern, not a novel invention.
